LAMATION NO. 359 DATED DECEMPER 16, 193.
WhEREAS, the late President Manuel Roxas had the
singular distinction of being the First President of the
Republic of the Philippines, in which position he ren-
dered invaluable services to the country up to the time
of his death in the performance of an official engagement
at Clark Field on April 15, 1948;
WHEREAS, the Filipino people, in expressing their gra-
titude for the patriotic services of the late President
Manuel Roxas, initiated the raising of funds by public
subscription for tho construction of an income-producing
Memorial for the purposes, among others, of immortal-
izing his memory, extending financial aid to needy or in-
digent war widows and to public charitable and social
welfare institutions, encouraging the development of
theatrical talents, and promoting theatrical arts and pro-
ductions and symphony orchestra music; and
WHEREAS, certain parcels of the public domain situated
in the City of Manila have been reserved for use as site
of the , Roxas Memorial under Proclamation No. 359,
dated December 16, 1952;
Now, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby create the Roxas Memorial Commission com-
posed of the following:
1. The Secretary of Public Works and Communi-
2. The Secretary of Commerce and Industry........ Vice-Chairman
3. The Administration of Economic Coordina-
4. Social Welfare Administrator, Social Welfare
Administration
b. The Treasurer of the Philippines
6. Director of Planning, National Planning Com-
7. Mrs. Trinidad de Leon Vda, de Roxas ..
8. The President of the War Widows
9. The President, Chamber of Commerce of the
Philippines
10. The President, Manila Theaters Association... Member
11. The Chairman, Board of Trustees, Arts Coun
cil of the Philippines
The Commission shall be in charge of a nation-wide
campaign for raising funds for the construction of the
Roxas Memorial on the site reserved therefor by Procla-
mation No. 359 dated December 16, 1952. The Com-
mission is hereby authorized to create and organize as
many subcommittees as it may deem necessary in the
provinces, chartered cities and municipalities, and to

promulgate rules and regulations to cary out the sork
entrusted to it.
The Commission shall meet as such times and places
as may be designated by the Chairman and shall sub-
mit its report to the President from time to time.
All funds coming into the Commission shall be deposited
with the Philippine National Bank or with any other
banking institution authorized to do business in the Phil-
ippines, and the necessary withdrawls therefrom shall
be made only by checks duly signed by the Treasurer of
the Commission and countersigned by the Chairman and
by the Auditor to be designated by the Auditor General.
Ail books of accounts kept in connection with the raising
of funds and disbursement thereof shall always be made
available for audit by the authorized representative of
the Auditor General.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,.
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
